rv.q: Open Air artistic director Timothy Sheader has staged a joyous revival of this old-fashioned, delightful show.
If you don’t leave with a smile on your face, I will eat my tap shoes.

cn.t: Critics agree this Gershwin-packed extravaganza delivers dazzling song and dance, though its plot is wafer-thin. A joyful, old-fashioned crowd-pleaser for musical theatre fans, if not a show likely to win over skeptics.
